rows.ARS:
Orange blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: KORgane
Exhibition name: Las Vegas
rows.Origin:
Bred by Reimer Kordes (1922-1997) (Germany, before 1972).
Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Retail) in 1982 as 'Las Vegas'.
rows.Bloom: Orange, yellow reverse. Moderate fragrance. 26 petals. Average diameter 5". Very large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, cluster-flowered, in small clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Large, pointed buds.
rows.Habit:
Medium, bushy, upright. Medium, semi-glossy, medium green, leathery foliage. 5 leaflets.

Height: up to 4½' (up to 135cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
